about.title: About BlackDark
about.lead: Institutional-grade market intelligence built for clarity, not noise — one clear Act or Wait decision backed by transparent evidence.
about.p1: BlackDark is an institutional-grade market intelligence platform built for clarity, not noise. It delivers one clear Act or Wait decision on major crypto assets, backed by transparent evidence and a public accuracy ledger that publishes both hits and misses.
about.p2: Unlike traditional dashboards that overwhelm users with endless charts, BlackDark focuses on a single, actionable signal supported by three key factors, a sealed decision certificate, and verifiable outcomes after 24 hours. Every decision is logged, resolved, and made public so users can verify performance themselves.
about.capabilities.title: Core Capabilities
about.capability.1: Single-sentence Oracle decisions with live freshness and factor breakdown
about.capability.2: Public Accuracy Ledger with hash-chained proof of hits and misses
about.capability.3: Trust Pulse for real-time Act/Wait signals under five seconds
about.capability.4: Sealed Prediction Markets with timed certificates and public resolution
about.capability.5: Verified Miss Bounty for reported model errors with subscription credit
about.capability.6: Arb Opportunities for cross-venue price discrepancies (paid users)
about.capability.7: Discipline Mirror for private follow-vs-override tracking
about.capability.9: Glass Box Challenge for public verification
about.capability.11: Institutional-grade data provenance and audit trail
about.disclaimer: BlackDark is an analytical research tool. It is not financial advice. All outcomes, including misses, are published on the Public Accuracy Ledger for independent verification.
